questions.answer: Det er lidt svært og desværre også ret dyrt, så start i så god tid som muligt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: UCC har en online platform, hvor man vælger sine fag. Den er åben et stykke tid efter semesterstart, så man har også mulighed for at ændre sine fag, hvis man finder ud af, at man hellere vil vælge andre fag end dem, man først har meldt sig på. For jura var registreringsprocessen lidt anderledes, men stadig meget lige til.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Før du ankom, kunne du kontakte dem via e-mail eller ringe til International Office. Efter ankomst kunne man også bare gå direkte ned til International Office og spørge om hjælp.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det var fint.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Fordi man har mulighed for at ændre sit valg af fag, så kan man bare tage det stille og roligt, når man melder sig på nogle fag i starten.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det har været så fint.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Undervisningsstilen er som udgangspunkt forholdsvis anderledes end KU, men det afhænger også af, hvilke fag du har. I nogle fag er deltagelse en stor del, da man får points for det, som tæller med til eksamen, mens andre fag er mere styret af underviseren.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Legal Research and Writing, International Child Justice og Intellectual Property law.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Det vigtigste er bare, at du vælger ud fra dine interesser.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Når du vælger fag, så undersøg eksamensformen - på den måde kan du bedre tilrettelægge dit skema. 
Find din bolig i god tid og prioriter at bo tæt på centrum.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I starten af semesteret er der en 'swap shop', hvor det er muligt at få ting, som er blevet efterladt af tidligere studerende mod en lille donation på ca. 3 euro. Tingene fejler intet, så det kan betale sig at kigge derned, før du køber nyt.
